issues.description: The full sample-construction branch requires four hand-collected workbooks named by the do-file, but they are not in the package inventory. The datasheet describes human collection/coding and M-turk classification, so rebuilding the authors’ classifications from public SEC releases is not a supported substitute.

The do-file merges proposed_topic_N.dta and final_topic_N.dta but supplies no producer or construction instructions. Both files are absent, and the topic assignments affect the analysis sample. The post-append step also consumes PublicationYearLastUpdate, so the final topic file’s required fields must be confirmed.

The datasheet identifies two survey datasets and references paper-specific online-appendix instructions, but the supplied Stata workflow does not identify a survey-analysis entry point. The bundled appendix title concerns Relative Valuation with Machine Learning and does not appear to match this paper. Clarify whether survey analyses are outside this code scope or provide the missing workflow and correct appendix.

The Figure 3–5 branches issue twoway graph commands but do not specify persistent figure files. Confirm filenames, format and destination before proposing graph-export edits; do not infer an output format.

The do-file hard-codes Windows paths for the data root and table output directory. Configure these assignments for a local writable tree with the expected Raw_data/Cleaned_data layout and output path before execution.

review_notes: The full_pipeline scope covers every section of the provided Stata file; closure remains incomplete because the topic maps have no producer, hand-collected source workbooks are absent, and the datasheet describes survey inputs without a matching survey-analysis entry point.

analysis_only is intentionally limited to all Table 4, Table 5 and Table 6 regression models. The datasheet identifies the two packaged datasets as the final regression samples. Fresh bounded probes confirm readability, required fields, 357 and 105 file-level observations, respectively; each sampled one row for column metadata and coverage_verified remains false.

Actual producer order is citation_merged2/citation_merged_doc_level, then word.dta, mandatory.dta and CL.dta, then document_regsample, followed by doc_CL_sample and CL_regsample, then Part B figures and tables. Figure 3–4 and Table 3 use citation_merged2; Figure 5 uses doc_CL_sample; Tables 4–5 use document_regsample; Table 6 uses CL_regsample.

Stata 18 and unique are available from bounded probes. The full workflow invokes nvals(); its exact _gnvals entry point was confirmed available. The separate package-name which egenmore result was not treated as evidence that this function was absent. All Table 4–6 branches need outreg2, which remains missing. No author code, regressions, installs or dataset downloads were run.
